scanners.name: Intraday Gappers
scanners.definition: The session opened away from the previous close by at least a set percent; optional pre-open volume, daily turnover and daily range checks.
scanners.text: Abs(DayOpen() - PDC()) / PDC() * 100 >= $gap_pct AND ($pre_vol <= 0 OR PreOpenVolume() >= $pre_vol) AND SMA(close * volume, 20)@1d >= $min_turnover AND ATR(14)@1d / close * 100 >= $min_atr_pct

params.name: gap_pct
params.doc: Gap from the previous close to the session's open, in percent (up or down).

params.name: pre_vol
params.doc: Volume of the pre-open bars (shares). Needs pre-open bars in your data, else not available. 0 = no volume condition.

params.name: min_turnover
params.doc: Average daily turnover (close x volume) over 20 sessions, in rupees. 0 = no volume condition.

params.name: min_atr_pct
params.doc: Daily ATR(14) as a percent of the price: the stock's normal daily range.

scanners.footer: Information and education only, not investment advice.

scanners.name: New Day High
scanners.definition: A close above the session's high so far, on high volume for the time of day, the session's volume above normal and a recent range wide enough to move.
scanners.text: DayExtremeBreak("up", $v, $vwap, $skip, $k) AND RelVolumeTOD(20, "bar") <= $v_max AND RelVolumeTOD(20, "cumulative") >= $cum_v AND Max(high, $range_bars) - Min(low, $range_bars) >= $range_atr * ATR(14)[1]

params.name: v
params.doc: This bar's volume against the same time of day in the last 20 sessions (4 = 400 %). 0 = no volume condition.

params.name: vwap
params.doc: The close is on the side of the session VWAP the move goes to.

params.name: skip
params.doc: No signal from a bar that starts in the first N minutes of the session.

params.name: k
params.doc: The close must be beyond the session's high or low so far by at least this many ATRs.

params.name: v_max
params.doc: At most this multiple of the same time of day's volume on this bar (20 = 2,000 %).

params.name: cum_v
params.doc: The session's volume so far against the average by the same time.

params.name: range_bars
params.doc: Bars of the recent range (3 bars of 5 minutes = 15 minutes).

params.name: range_atr
params.doc: The recent range is at least this many ATRs.

scanners.footer: Information and education only, not investment advice.

scanners.name: New Day Low
scanners.definition: A close below the session's low so far, on high volume for the time of day, the session's volume above normal and a recent range wide enough to move.
scanners.text: DayExtremeBreak("down", $v, $vwap, $skip, $k) AND RelVolumeTOD(20, "bar") <= $v_max AND RelVolumeTOD(20, "cumulative") >= $cum_v AND Max(high, $range_bars) - Min(low, $range_bars) >= $range_atr * ATR(14)[1]

params.name: v
params.doc: This bar's volume against the same time of day in the last 20 sessions (4 = 400 %). 0 = no volume condition.

params.name: vwap
params.doc: The close is on the side of the session VWAP the move goes to.

params.name: skip
params.doc: No signal from a bar that starts in the first N minutes of the session.

params.name: k
params.doc: The close must be beyond the session's high or low so far by at least this many ATRs.

params.name: v_max
params.doc: At most this multiple of the same time of day's volume on this bar (20 = 2,000 %).

params.name: cum_v
params.doc: The session's volume so far against the average by the same time.

params.name: range_bars
params.doc: Bars of the recent range (3 bars of 5 minutes = 15 minutes).

params.name: range_atr
params.doc: The recent range is at least this many ATRs.

scanners.footer: Information and education only, not investment advice.

scanners.name: Top Reversal
scanners.definition: A large rise from the session's open, then a bearish reversal candle at or near the session's high.
scanners.text: SessionHigh() - DayOpen() >= $move_atr * ATR(14)[1] AND SessionHigh() - high <= $near_atr * ATR(14)[1] AND (Pattern("shooting_star") OR Pattern("bearish_engulfing") OR Pattern("evening_star"))

params.name: move_atr
params.doc: The rise from the session's open to its high so far, in ATRs.

params.name: near_atr
params.doc: The bar's high is at most this many ATRs below the session's high.

scanners.footer: Information and education only, not investment advice.

scanners.name: Bottom Reversal
scanners.definition: A large fall from the session's open, then a bullish reversal candle at or near the session's low.
scanners.text: DayOpen() - SessionLow() >= $move_atr * ATR(14)[1] AND low - SessionLow() <= $near_atr * ATR(14)[1] AND (Pattern("hammer") OR Pattern("bullish_engulfing") OR Pattern("morning_star"))

params.name: move_atr
params.doc: The rise from the session's open to its high so far, in ATRs.

params.name: near_atr
params.doc: The bar's high is at most this many ATRs below the session's high.

scanners.footer: Information and education only, not investment advice.

scanners.name: VWAP Break
scanners.definition: The close crosses above the session VWAP on high volume for the time of day; the mirror reads the cross below.

params.name: v
params.doc: This bar's volume against the same time of day in the last 20 sessions. 0 = no volume condition.

scanners.footer: Information and education only, not investment advice.

scanners.name: Circuit Watch
scanners.definition: The last price is within a set percent of the day's upper or lower price band, as your broker's quote reports it.

params.name: near_pct
params.doc: Distance from the price band, in percent of the last price. Needs a broker whose quote reports the band, else not available.

scanners.footer: Information and education only, not investment advice.

scanners.name: RSI Extreme
scanners.definition: 5-minute RSI above a high level or below a low level, with the session's volume so far and the price inside a set range.
scanners.text: (RSI($n)@5m >= $hi OR RSI($n)@5m <= $lo) AND close >= $pmin AND close <= $pmax AND ($min_vol <= 0 OR SessionVolume() >= $min_vol)

params.name: n
params.doc: RSI period on 5-minute bars.

params.name: hi
params.doc: RSI at or above this level.

params.name: lo
params.doc: RSI at or below this level.

params.name: pmin
params.doc: Lowest price, in rupees.

params.name: pmax
params.doc: Highest price, in rupees.

params.name: min_vol
params.doc: The session's volume so far (shares). 0 = no volume condition.

scanners.footer: Information and education only, not investment advice.

scanners.name: Volume Surge
scanners.definition: Volume against the average of the same time of day in previous sessions: this bar, or the session so far.

params.name: sessions
params.doc: Previous sessions in the time-of-day average.

params.name: mode
params.doc: bar: this bar's volume; cumulative: the session's volume so far.

params.name: v
params.doc: At least this multiple of the time-of-day average.

scanners.footer: Information and education only, not investment advice.

scanners.name: Key Levels
scanners.definition: The close is within a set distance of a key level: previous close, high or low, pre-open high or low, moving averages or the 52-week high or low.
scanners.text: Abs(close - PDC()) / close * 100 <= $tol_pct OR Abs(close - PDH()) / close * 100 <= $tol_pct OR Abs(close - PDL()) / close * 100 <= $tol_pct OR Abs(close - Lag(high, 1)@1d) / close * 100 <= $tol_pct OR Abs(close - Lag(low, 1)@1d) / close * 100 <= $tol_pct OR Abs(close - PreOpenHigh()) / close * 100 <= $tol_pct OR Abs(close - PreOpenLow()) / close * 100 <= $tol_pct OR Abs(close - SMA(close, $sma_a)@1d) / close * 100 <= $tol_pct OR Abs(close - SMA(close, $sma_b)@1d) / close * 100 <= $tol_pct OR Abs(close - EMA(close, $ema_a)) / close * 100 <= $tol_pct OR Abs(close - EMA(close, $ema_b)) / close * 100 <= $tol_pct OR Abs(close - Max(high, 250)@1d) / close * 100 <= $tol_pct OR Abs(close - Min(low, 250)@1d) / close * 100 <= $tol_pct

params.name: tol_pct
params.doc: Distance from the level, in percent of the price.

params.name: sma_a
params.doc: Daily simple moving average.

params.name: sma_b
params.doc: Daily simple moving average.

params.name: ema_a
params.doc: Exponential moving average on the scan's own bars.

params.name: ema_b
params.doc: Exponential moving average on the scan's own bars.

scanners.footer: Information and education only, not investment advice.

scanners.name: Graded Key Levels
scanners.definition: The close is near a previous-session or pre-open level whose grade - touches, a recent visit, its kind, a round number, a level close by - has the set points.
scanners.text: LevelGrade("PDC", "grade", $near, $look, $touches, $recent, $tier) >= $min_grade AND Abs(close - PDC()) <= $near * ATR(14) OR LevelGrade("PDH", "grade", $near, $look, $touches, $recent, $tier) >= $min_grade AND Abs(close - PDH()) <= $near * ATR(14) OR LevelGrade("PDL", "grade", $near, $look, $touches, $recent, $tier) >= $min_grade AND Abs(close - PDL()) <= $near * ATR(14) OR LevelGrade("PREOPEN_HIGH", "grade", $near, $look, $touches, $recent, $tier) >= $min_grade AND Abs(close - PreOpenHigh()) <= $near * ATR(14) OR LevelGrade("PREOPEN_LOW", "grade", $near, $look, $touches, $recent, $tier) >= $min_grade AND Abs(close - PreOpenLow()) <= $near * ATR(14)

params.name: near
params.doc: The level's band either side, in average true ranges of 14 bars (also the touch, round-number and nearby-level distance).

params.name: min_grade
params.doc: Points the level needs, out of 5.

params.name: look
params.doc: Bars in which the touches are counted.

params.name: touches
params.doc: Separate visits of the band for the touches point.

params.name: recent
params.doc: The last visit at most this many bars ago for the recent point.

params.name: tier
params.doc: Kinds that earn the kind point: 1 the previous close only, 2 also the previous high / low, 3 every level.

scanners.footer: Information and education only, not investment advice.
